scripts.check:web: pnpm format:check && turbo run lint typecheck && turbo run test && turbo run build
scripts.check:backend: uv run ruff check apps/backend && uv run ruff format --check apps/backend && uv run mypy apps/backend/api/src apps/backend/worker/src apps/backend/packages/domain/src apps/backend/packages/evaluation/src apps/backend/packages/persistence/src && uv run pytest -q apps/backend/api/tests apps/backend/worker/tests && uv run python scripts/check-backend-imports.py && uv run --package fisheye-worker fisheye-worker
scripts.check:database: node scripts/require-test-database.mjs && uv run pytest -q -m integration apps/backend/api/tests
scripts.check: pnpm check:web && pnpm check:backend && pnpm check:database
scripts.api-client:generate: uv run --package fisheye-api python scripts/export-openapi.py && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @fisheye/api-client generate && pnpm exec prettier --write packages/api-client/src/generated/schema.d.ts
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package fisheye-api alembic -c apps/backend/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
